name: xpex-academy
description: XpeX Academy monorepo wrapper for development and preview tooling.

scripts.dev:web: bun run install:web && cd apps/web && bun run dev --hostname 0.0.0.0
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && LEARNHOUSE_DEVELOPMENT_MODE=true uv run uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-${LEARNHOUSE_PORT:-9000}} --reload
scripts.build: bun run install:web && cd apps/web && bun run build
